## Goal
Generate 30 NEW web site/app (desktop-first or responsive, used with mouse + keyboard) product/site topics for the scene below.

## Scene

(L2 key: 文化 · 商务型)

## Existing topics already in this scene (30) — your new topics MUST differ from EVERY one
1. 纪念品商店
2. 门票销售
3. 捐赠通道
4. 会员续费
5. Museum art print and reproduction licensing store
6. Heritage site guided tour booking and payment platform
7. Cultural center venue rental reservation portal
8. Performing arts season ticket purchase site
9. Nonprofit charity auction bidding platform
10. Government permit fee payment and processing portal
11. Cultural festival vendor booth reservation site
12. Art workshop and masterclass registration portal
13. Museum corporate event and private hire booking site
14. Public library fine payment and account top-up portal
15. Charity gift card and e-voucher purchase platform
16. Cultural heritage IP merchandise licensing marketplace
17. Museum café and private dining reservation site
18. Nonprofit fundraising merchandise online store
19. Government public facility rental and scheduling portal
20. Cultural documentary and film screening ticket site
21. Official publication and document print-on-demand store
22. Nonprofit grant application fee payment portal
23. Cultural foundation corporate sponsorship package site
24. Museum educational program and field trip booking portal

26. Charity raffle and lottery ticket sales platform
27. Government apostille and document certification fee portal
28. Art gallery private viewing and consultation booking site
29. Cultural organization branded apparel online store
30. Public archive digital image licensing and download store

## Hard requirements
1. Output a JSON array of EXACTLY 30 new topic strings, in English.
2. Each topic = a concrete, buildable product/site idea, 4-12 words. Not a generic feature name.
3. CRITICAL — in-scene differentiation: every new topic must be a genuinely different
   sub-niche or use-case from EVERY existing topic listed above. Do NOT produce
   paraphrases, synonyms, renamings, or minor variations. Example: if "freelance
   invoice tracker" already exists, do NOT emit "invoice management tool for
   freelancers". If an idea overlaps in concept with any existing topic, discard it
   and find a different angle (different audience, sub-domain, mechanic, or context).
4. The 30 new topics must also be clearly distinct from each other.
5. Stay strictly within the scene — every topic must clearly belong to: 文化 / 公益 / 政务组织 × ④ 商务型
6. Lean web-native: e.g. "open-source contributor leaderboard site", not a phone-only idea.
7. Output pure JSON — a single array of strings. No markdown fences, no commentary.

Return ONLY the JSON array of 30 strings.
